Shared-memory metrics layout, access macros, and time conversion helpers.

# Purpose
`fd_metrics.h` defines the shared-memory metrics layout and access helpers used by the application. It declares thread-local pointers for the metrics base and tile area, and it provides macros for setting, getting, and copying gauge, counter, and histogram values with direct indexed writes. The file also defines the memory footprint and alignment rules for a metrics object, plus inline functions to create, register, join, leave, and delete the metrics region. It includes time conversion helpers so histogram bucket limits can be expressed in seconds, ticks, or nanoseconds with the same tick rate used by the runtime.
